semiconductor_relevance: High — TongChao Precision specializes in core materials and components for semiconductor equipment, directly supporting the integrated circuits and display panel sectors.
summary: Established in 2016, TongChao Precision Machinery Co., Ltd focuses on the preparation, processing, and surface treatment of essential materials for semiconductor equipment. The company offers a range of high-purity silicon, quartz, metal, and advanced ceramic components, aiming to support the localization of core components in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: TongChao has production bases in Wuhu, Hefei, and Mianyang, integrating into the supply chains of leading domestic manufacturers.
